news.title: Veteran college athletics administrator Shawn Eichorst appointed University of Wisconsin Director of Athletics
news.summary_en: A proven and respected college sports executive, attorney and former collegiate athlete, Shawn Eichorst has been appointed as the University of Wisconsin–Madison's Director of Athletics.

news.title: Helping new Badgers feel at home
news.summary_en: Student orientation leaders for the annual SOAR program spend their summers guiding incoming UW–Madison students through their transition to college.

news.title: With a focus on the Great Lakes, UW faculty and staff reflect on the Wisconsin Idea
news.summary_en: This year’s Wisconsin Idea Seminar highlighted the ancient waterways of Wisconsin and how they continue to sustain life and community across the state.
